parent_objective: run or implement margin-banded no-training outcome probe over late-reveal matched/bucketed rows
blocked_by: M1400 materialized late-reveal source rows but did not test normal margin bands or outcome interventions
supersedes: training directly from M1400 source rows
claiming self-identification from late-reveal source materialization

public_gates: M1401 must run or implement no-training outcome interventions over M1400 matched/bucketed rows
M1401 must report normal-margin bands and strict-vs-bucketed accepted-row splits
M1401 must report reveal-step and source-diversity splits for accepted rows
M1401 must not train, run PPO, promote, use private holdout, export a training corpus, or change actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not count reset-only or zero-current-only rows as self-identification
do not count source materialization as outcome evidence

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether M1400 late-reveal rows produce near-boundary source-diverse outcome gaps under history interventions
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: public no-training outcome probe only; no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if near-boundary candidates are too sparse
stop if accepted rows remain seed-singleton
stop if wrong-warmup and delayed-history variants remain zero
stop if reset or zero-current controls dominate accepted outcomes
fallback_plan: route to reveal-grid redesign if 64/72/80 remain too easy
route to mild warmup stimulus design if late reveal alone is insufficient
route to branch synthesis if late-reveal outcome evidence remains source-narrow

admission_evidence: M1400 source smoke structurally passed with 1604 source rows and 256 matched/bucketed rows
M1400 matched/bucketed rows span 23 seeds, 16 capability pairs, and 92 reveal buckets
M1400 did not train, run outcome interventions, promote, export corpus, or change actor inputs
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: outcome intervention variants are materialized or infeasibility is classified
accepted-row source and reveal-step diversity are reported

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1401 must distinguish near-boundary history effects from reset/zero-current controls and source materialization.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: No-training outcome interventions over M1400 late-reveal matched/bucketed rows.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If outcome gaps are absent, control-dominated, or source-narrow, record the negative and route to reveal-grid or warmup-stimulus redesign before training.
allowed_claims: no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, high-fidelity, paper-level result, or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: No-training margin-banded outcome interventions over M1400 late-reveal rows can determine whether stronger reveal pressure creates source-diverse history-relevant outcome gaps.
success_criteria: normal reset zero-current delayed wrong-warmup same-recent-wrong-warmup and shortened/removed-warmup variants are reported or cleanly rejected
normal-margin bands and accepted-row source/reveal-step diversity are reported
result chooses next route without training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, training corpus export, or actor-input expansion
failure_criteria: source or reveal-step diversity is not reported
result routes directly to training or claim expansion

commands.name: implementation_or_run
commands.command: implement or run no-training margin-banded late-reveal outcome probe

decision_rule: M1401 passes structurally if it materializes no-training margin-banded outcome interventions over M1400 rows and reports source/reveal-step diversity without claim expansion.
